title: Uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros

abstractEnglish: We prove the uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros. There is an absolute constant c > 0 such that every real zero $`\beta\in(0,1)`$ of every primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet L-function of conductor q ≥ 3 satisfies $`(1-\beta)\log q\ge c`$.
